confidence_notes: Medium. Search summaries (pages not opened directly) support the restaurant anchors best: Cardiff inexpensive meal ~GBP 15 and mid-range meal for two ~GBP 62 (Numbeo-derived), and pint ~GBP 4.90-5.35 (Numbeo-derived, Expatistan). Cappuccino rests on rough cafe-coffee ranges (GBP 2.80-3.70) plus general knowledge. Cocktail rests on crowd-sourced and guide ranges (GBP 7-12). No current Cardiff glass-of-wine price was found, so wine uses ~1.2x the pint price and the UK ONS-reported 175ml average (GBP 5.17 in Jan 2025), uplifted. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for July 2026, not live listings. It is the least certain, and event weekends can run much higher. GBP was converted at an assumed ~1.34 USD/GBP, which was not searched. FX is the RBA 4:00 pm observation of 18 Nov 2026 as shown on its exchange rates page in search results; no 19 Nov observation was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Cardiff-specific aggregated figures. Cocktail and wine are scaled off the local pint price (cocktail ~1.9x, 175ml glass ~1.2x), which is typical of UK on-trade pricing. Accommodation is treated like other mid-sized UK regional cities such as Bristol, Manchester and Birmingham: a bit below Bristol and Edinburgh and well below London.
